# NoClip

**Category:** Movement  
**Aliases:** NoClip

## What it does

NoClip lets you move freely through solid blocks as if they weren't there. Once enabled, your character ignores all collision with the terrain, letting you glide through walls, floors, ceilings, and other solid geometry. To activate it reliably, let a falling block (such as sand or gravel) land on your head first — this nudges the server into a state where the movement is accepted.

Description basis: [publisher description](https://liquidbounce.net/docs/modules/movement/noclip). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).

## Client variants

### [Wurst — NoClip](https://github.com/Wurst-Imperium/Wurst7/blob/4fa258b7b339f1823e73ae8455c404209e3690cd/src/main/java/net/wurstclient/hacks/NoClipHack.java)

Allows you to teleport through up to 21 blocks (or 37 with elytra equipped).  You must be at least partially inside a block to start, e.g. by dropping sand on yourself or walking into a door while it's moving. You won't be pushed out of the block while NoClip is enabled.  Then just use the movement keys (including jump/sneak) to choose a direction and you'll appear on the other side. Nothing will happen if there are too many blocks to get through.  WARNING: Teleporting down can cause a lot of fall damage, even with NoFall!

Basis: [publisher description](https://github.com/Wurst-Imperium/Wurst7/blob/4fa258b7b339f1823e73ae8455c404209e3690cd/src/main/resources/assets/wurst/translations/en_us.json).
